title: Brigitte Bardot’s 285 belongings beat a €50,000 estimate, fetching €953,531 at Paris auction
summary_full: A remarkable auction of Brigitte Bardot's personal belongings in Paris drew in almost €1 million, exceeding expectations by a significant margin. The sale included 285 unique items sourced from Bardot's residences, with proceeds aimed at funding her animal welfare foundation and supporting her only child. Although Bardot's last spouse expressed concerns over the auction's appropriateness, the foundation confirmed its approval, furthering Bardot’s enduring commitment to animal rights.
